versions.changelog:
**Life Companion 2.0.0 – major update**

- Improved onboarding: any module can answer on first turn; only collecting data or saving requires formal consent/onboarding.
- Expanded on how to resolve the skill directory, supporting more environments and adding robust detection.
- Enhanced safety protocol: proactively checks for low moods and crisis signs before engagement.
- New/updated scripts and data files add support for Chinese content and agent/occupation handling tools.
- Refined documentation, clarifying command usage, onboarding options (HTML/chat), and module routing.
- Skill card replaced by more comprehensive markdown/documentation.

**Life Companion v1.0.0 – Initial public release**

- Launched the core “life-companion” skill: a personal AI companion that supports one person across destiny charts (八字/BaZi), daily fortune & journaling, career fit, and relationship reflection.
- All user data is private and stored on-device; includes structured onboarding with strong consent and safety protocols.
- Honest computation/interpretation boundary strictly enforced: every calculation is factual and reproducible, every interpretation is always labeled as a mirror, never a prediction.
- Modular architecture with single-command “brief” summaries, follow-up system, and clear routing to individual modules (destiny, daily, career, relationship, journaling).
- Thorough documentation and safety framing included; first-use consent, no medical/financial/legal advice, and built-in crisis escalation.

Initial public release of Life Companion — a personal AI companion offering self-reflection through four distinct lenses.

- Supports one user over time, with secure, on-device profile and journal.
- Enables exploration and "readings" for: 八字/BaZi destiny charts, daily fortune & journaling, career fit, and relationship reflection.
- All computations are deterministic and reproducible; interpretations are clearly framed as perspectives (mirrors), not predictions.
- Starts with short, consent-based onboarding; prioritizes privacy and crisis safety at every step.
- Follows up gently on user intentions, creating a meaningful continuity across sessions.
- Structured for clear module separation and accessible both via chat and HTML forms.
